title: Simplicial presentations retaining the enriched functor calculus
statement:
Use the universes, quasicategories and simplicial functor sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], complete algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and enriched functors, internal functor categories, free enrichment and cotensors of [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a presentably closed symmetric monoidal infinity-category. Write $U\mathcal A$ for the quasicategory underlying a complete $\mathcal V$-category, whose mapping spaces are $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal V}(\mathbf1,\mathcal A(x,y))$.

A compatible enriched simplicial presentation consists of a simplicial category $\mathscr P$, a complete $\mathcal V$-category $E_p$ for each object $p$, quasicategories $\mathscr P(p,q)$, and equivalences
$$\mathscr P(p,q)\simeq U\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathcal V}(E_p,E_q),$$
compatible with horizontal composition, identities and evaluation, including all transformation simplices. It also includes a simplicial functor $U_{\mathscr P}:\mathscr P\to\mathsf{qCat}$ with $U_{\mathscr P}(p)\simeq UE_p$, whose maps on hom-quasicategories represent forgetting enrichment on functors and transformations. Here $\mathsf{qCat}(X,Y)=\operatorname{Fun}(X,Y)$, and composition and identities in both simplicial categories hold strictly. For every small simplicial set $S$ needed in a given calculation, the presentation includes models of $E_p^S$ and the cotensor comparison
$$\mathscr P(q,p^S)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(S,\mathscr P(q,p)),$$
with its coherent evaluation maps; $E_p^S=\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathcal V}(S_{\mathcal V},E_p)$, using the freely generated infinity-category of $S$. A presentation of a coherent diagram includes representatives of all its functors, transformations and higher simplices, with the above comparisons identifying them with the specified enriched data; replacement of a model is allowed only with these identifications retained.

Every small family of complete $\mathcal V$-categories and coherent enriched functor data admits such a presentation, enlarged to include any prescribed small collection of cotensors. Coherent monad data already given as an action of a simplicial walking monad can be represented by a simplicial functor into this presentation, with equivalent underlying action and its specified identifications. The same assertion holds for tensor-preserving functors between tensored categories with specified coherent tensor comparisons: the hom-quasicategories then retain the comparisons and transformations compatible with them. Forgetting these extra comparisons gives the preceding presentation. These existence assertions do not prescribe equality with both independently chosen triangle witnesses of an adjunction.

source.place: Agent-formulated simplicial presentation foundation for applying sections 4.3 and 5.1--5.2 to complete enriched categories; enriched internal Homs and cotensors from Haugseng, On the tensor product of enriched infinity-categories, Remark 9.5. Neither paper states this combined presentation assertion verbatim; archival copies WANTED. No Stacks tag supplies this assertion.
